items.title: Research on the Coordinated Development of Urban Green Infrastructure Construction and Carbon Neutrality
items.summary: This study systematically explores the intrinsic mechanism and implementation path of the coordinated development of urban green infrastructure (UGI) and carbon neutrality. Based on the four-dimensional analysis framework of input carbon effect synergy institutional guarantee, the contribution characteristics of UGI to carbon neutrality were revealed through remote sensing inversion, model simulation, and multiple case comparisons.
